status: research: season-trained coefficients applied to completed games
feature_source: traditional box plus outcome-invariant PBP playtype proxy
alpha_rule: largest alpha within one paired-season standard error of minimum chronological development MSE
normalization: 100 * season event count / side-specific canonical Net DECOMP possessions; game points cancel that normalization
training_weight: sqrt(side possessions), normalized to mean one within training fold
estimated_potential_assists: not included: existing backcast also requires assist points, bad-pass turnovers and PBP role fields; ordinary AST is explicit
pbp_shrinkage_status: explicit provisional 20-FGA sensitivity; not tuned or validated
headline: traditional-box coefficients; PBP role shown as explicit candidate and zTS diagnostic
